item.title: Kalshi and Polymarket election betting passes 220 million dollars for 2026 midterms — Oct 18, 2026 · 9:15 PM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi and Polymarket election betting passes 220 million dollars for 2026 midterms** — Wagering on the 2026 midterm elections across Kalshi and Polymarket has surpassed 220 million dollars, more than double the 92 million dollars recorded in the entire 2024 congressional cycle, according to a Reuters report citing the Anti-Corruption Data Collective. item.title: Ohio senator seeks prediction market regulation after Sixth Circuit ruling — Oct 18, 2026 · 9:15 PM ET
item.description: - **Ohio senator seeks prediction market regulation after Sixth Circuit ruling** — Ohio state Sen. Bill DeMora is calling for prediction markets to be regulated under state sports betting laws after the U.S. Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals said platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket can be regulated that way. In a statement released Oct. 15, DeMora said the decision solidifies that prediction markets are not exempt from Ohio law and that Ohio is losing tens of millions of dollars every month by not regulating the sites.
